title: LAPSLens (com.joshua-d-miller.lapslens)
description: LAPSLens 3.x settings. Upload as a Jamf Pro Application & Custom Settings schema for the preference domain com.joshua-d-miller.lapslens. Unset keys use the built-in defaults; set keys can't be changed by the user.

ClipboardClearSeconds.title: Clear clipboard after (seconds)
ClipboardClearSeconds.description: Seconds before a copied password is cleared from the clipboard, if nothing else was copied since. 0 = never.

AutoHideSeconds.title: Hide password after (seconds)
AutoHideSeconds.description: Seconds before a revealed password is hidden again. 0 = never.
